heroHeadline: Turkey Joins Saudi Coalition Against Houthis as Russia Blocks Mediation
heroSubtitle: Turkey announced military support for Saudi Arabia against Houthi forces in a significant regional realignment, while Russia denied any request to mediate — shutting down a key diplomatic channel as the Yemen conflict draws in new major powers.
footerNote: Data sourced from Saudi Press Agency, Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP, Washington Post, Bloomberg, NBC News, CNN, NPR, ABC News (Australia), TASS, Türkiye Today, Anadolu Agency, News.Az, Yemen Monitor, Arab News, UN OCHA, UN News, World Health Organization, Security Council Report, CFR Global Conflict Tracker, Trading Economics, and the US Senate Armed Services Committee record.
